notes: Documentation data only. Not read by Stirrup code. Paste these values into Settings → MCP servers when connecting Google's remote MCP endpoints. Client ID and secret come from the operator's Google Cloud Web application OAuth client. Redirect URI is always <WEB_ORIGIN>/mcp/oauth/callback.

servers.name: Gmail
servers.notes: Enable gmail.googleapis.com and gmailmcp.googleapis.com. Tick Use this client for an AI-powered agent on the Web application OAuth client. gmail.readonly, gmail.compose and gmail.modify are restricted scopes.

servers.name: Drive
servers.notes: Enable drive.googleapis.com and drivemcp.googleapis.com. drive.file is non-sensitive; drive.readonly is restricted. Prefer drive.file alone when per-file access is enough.

servers.name: Calendar
servers.notes: Enable calendar-json.googleapis.com and calendarmcp.googleapis.com. Confirm each Calendar scope's sensitivity class on the Cloud console Data Access page; treat them as sensitive for verification planning.
